server.address.description: Network address and port for the DHCP server to listen on (e.g., '192.168.1.1:67' or ':67' for all interfaces).

server.log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging. Options: debug, info, warn, error.

server.ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support (DHCPv6) in addition to IPv4 (DHCPv4).

plugins.description: List of plugins to load at startup. Each entry is either a builtin plugin name or a path to a shared library.

leases.backend.description: Lease storage backend. 'file' persists leases across restarts; 'memory' resets on reload.

leases.path.description: Path to the lease file when using the 'file' backend. Ignored for 'memory' backend.

network.description: Base IP address of the subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.0').

prefix.description: Subnet prefix length (e.g., 24 for /24). Optional; defaults to standard classful if omitted.

gateway.description: IP address of the default gateway/router for the subnet.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS server addresses to advertise to clients.

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP server addresses to advertise to clients.

start.description: First IP in the dynamic allocation range (inclusive).

end.description: Last IP in the dynamic allocation range (inclusive).

options.description: Arbitrary DHCP options (e.g., 'bootfile_name: pxelinux.0', 'vendor_class_id: 'PXEClient'') in key-value form.

global_options.description: Global DHCP options applied to all subnets unless overridden. Example: {'vendor_class_id': 'CoreDHCP', 'bootfile_name': 'coredhcp.pxe'}.
